faq.title: Good to know
faq.q1: Is {brand} a bank or exchange holding my money?
faq.a1: No. Your money stays in your own account, not ours. We can't freeze it or move it.
faq.q2: Do I need to understand crypto to use it?
faq.a2: No. Sign in like any app, fund by bank transfer, and buy assets like you'd shop online.
faq.a3: Stocks, gold, government bonds, leveraged trading, prediction markets, and instant swaps today. Auto-earn and collectibles are next.
faq.q4: How do I fund my account?
faq.a4: Transfer from your bank. It converts in seconds, and you can withdraw back to your bank just as fast.
faq.a5: We're rolling out access in waves. Sign up now to be near the front of the line.
